summary: Controls and automation work for manufacturing equipment with a focus on PLC logic, drive integration, and operator-facing tooling.
bullets: Developed and iterated ControlLogix ladder logic for conveyors, sensors, and safety interlocks to stabilize automated material flow.
Integrated VFDs, photoeyes, and motor starters; validated I/O maps and fault handling during commissioning.
Built Ignition HMI/SCADA views and alarm logic to speed troubleshooting and operator handoff.
Documented electrical schematics, panel layouts, and change logs to support maintenance and future upgrades.

summary: Computational research in protein allostery and molecular dynamics with an emphasis on reproducible analysis pipelines.
bullets: Designed Python pipelines to process molecular dynamics trajectories and compute allostery metrics (CARDS) across large ensembles.
Validated liposome and micelle clustering workflows with statistical checks and publication-grade visualizations.
Automated data ingest, batching, and report generation to ensure reproducible analysis across experiments.
Collaborated with lab members to translate biological hypotheses into computational experiments.

summary: Lead multidisciplinary teams building medical device concepts from requirements through functional prototypes.
bullets: Led cross-functional teams through requirements, risk analysis, and design reviews for multiple medical device concepts.
Directed rapid prototyping and benchtop testing to iterate mechanisms and sensing subsystems.
Coordinated documentation, purchasing, and fabrication to keep builds on schedule and within budget.
Mentored new members on electronics, embedded integration, and verification planning.
